nb_uniq_visitors	nb_users	nb_visits	nb_actions	nb_visits_converted	bounce_count	sum_visit_length	max_actions	bounce_rate	nb_actions_per_visit	avg_time_on_site

GenericSuccessXml.description: Generic Matomo success payload in XML.

ErrorXml.description: Generic Matomo error payload in XML.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not allowed to access the resource.

GenericString.description: Generic 200 response with only a string body

GenericBoolean.description: Generic 200 response with only true or false as the body

GenericInteger.description: Generic 200 response with only an integer as the body

formatRequired.name: format
formatRequired.description: Response format such as `xml` or `json`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.

formatOptional.name: format
formatOptional.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.

flatOptional.name: flat
flatOptional.description: Flatten subtables into the parent table.

filter_columnOptional.name: filter_column
filter_columnOptional.description: Column to apply the regex to (e.g., `label`).

filter_column_recursiveOptional.name: filter_column_recursive
filter_column_recursiveOptional.description: Column for the recursive regex filter.

filter_excludelowpopOptional.name: filter_excludelowpop
filter_excludelowpopOptional.description: Column to threshold and exclude low values.

filter_truncateOptional.name: filter_truncate
filter_truncateOptional.description: Row index after which rows are removed.

filter_limitOptional.name: filter_limit
filter_limitOptional.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

hideColumnsOptional.name: hideColumns
hideColumnsOptional.description: Comma-separated list of columns to hide.

showColumnsOptional.name: showColumns
showColumnsOptional.description: Comma-separated list of columns to include.

labelOptional.name: label
labelOptional.description: Keep only rows with these label(s). Supports path via '>' and arrays.

idGoalRequired.name: idGoal
idGoalRequired.description: The ID of a configured goal.

idGoalOptional.name: idGoal
idGoalOptional.description: The ID of a configured goal.

MatomoToken.description: Matomo API token passed in the Authorization header as a bearer token. For demo.matomo.cloud requests, use the anonymous token value: anonymous.

tags.name: VisitsSummary
tags.description: VisitsSummary API lets you access the core web analytics metrics (visits, unique visitors, count of actions (page views & downloads & clicks on outlinks), time on site, bounces and converted visits.
